title: Origyn NFT
tagline: Origyn NFT is a multi-asset, marketplace ready, cross-chain NFT with the capacity to store up to two gigs of resources on chain.
description: This project combines blockchain technology with browser-based front end to allow originators create powerful NFTs with endless possibilities. One of the more compelling features of Origyn NFT is the marketplace within. This feature allows originators and consumers to create value in a perpetual reward system.
how_its_made: Origyn NFT uses Internet Computer canisters or smart contracts which have on-chain storage space for up to two gigs. This feature allows to store lots of metadata, for example, we can create a NFT with preview pictures and/or HD/4K pictures or videos. We used ScaffoldETH to mint the NFTs on Polygon and to point the URI to the IC URL.  At that url the creator can put multiple libraries, experiences, and dapps.  The Origyn NFT is written in Motoko and eth scaffold is a combination of solidity and JS.
